title: Project Arsenal Qualified Method Record v0 (re-declared)
description: Closed-shape validation of Project Arsenal's reproduction of the engineering-system qualified-method-record/v0 contract. The schema enforces the documented minimum record (status, qualified_for, inputs, outputs, procedure_ref, evaluation, provenance) and the documented invariants (qualification is context-bound; failures and exclusions are first-class). It does NOT redefine the contract; consumers that need the engineering-system contract should resolve the original schema id there. This schema only validates records Project Arsenal emits.

schema.description: Schema identity must match the accepted engineering-system contract.

fixture.description: When true, the record is a fixture and carries no qualification claim. Records without fixture=true must satisfy the non-fixture invariants.

method_id.description: Stable identifier of the method being qualified. Project Arsenal uses the prefix repository-recon/ for Repository Recon methods and adds a method-name suffix.

status.description: Method maturity. experimental = observed but not gate-qualified; qualified = gate satisfied for the declared context only.

outcome.description: The user-visible outcome the method is bound to (e.g. understand-a-repository).

contexts.description: The contexts in which the qualification claim holds.

exclusions.description: Explicit contexts or conditions the record does NOT cover. Negative knowledge is first-class.

procedure_ref.description: Provenance digest of the procedure. fixture-only is permitted only when the record is explicitly a fixture; all other records must carry a real SHA-256.

evidence_refs.description: Provenance references (sha256, file paths, etc.) to the evidence base.

models.description: Model identifiers whose observed behavior contributed to the evidence base.

repositories.description: Repository identifiers the evidence base was observed on.

observed_strengths.description: Concrete observed strengths. Each entry must be a positive observation, not a category.

observed_failures.description: Concrete observed failures or qualifications gaps. Required for experimental records.

confidence.description: Confidence level. bounded and limited are permitted for experimental records; qualified-for-declared-context requires status=qualified.

qualification_gap.description: Optional explicit gap statement when the evidence is not yet sufficient for qualification.

arsenal_commit.description: The Arsenal commit SHA the record was authored against. Null is permitted for fixture and experimental records authored before the commit is final; qualified records must carry a real commit SHA.

record_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the record itself (with the digest field set to its placeholder).

allOf.description: experimental records must declare observed_failures and a non-positive confidence
experimental records may carry a null arsenal_commit because the record is authored before promotion; qualified records must carry a real commit SHA
fixtures must declare fixture=true and may carry placeholder digests
